---
title: "Uncertainty-based prediction deferral in radiomics models: a large-scale reproducible analysis with multiple open datasets"
authors:
  - José Guilherme de Almeida
  - Nickolas Papanikolaou
format: html
editor: visual
---

# Abstract

Here, we trained CatBoost models for all datasets in [radMLBench](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39270457/), a publicly available dataset of pre-computed radiomic features with clinically relevant targets. We filtered results to consider only datasets with > 100 samples, yielding a total of 29 datasets (out of the original 50). For all models, we perform hyperparameter optimisation using [Optuna](https://optuna.org/) for the number of estimators (between 50 and 150) and the learning rate (between $10^{-3}$ and $0.5$), and calibrate each classifier individually using isotonic calibration with k-fold cross-validation (CV; k=3). We then test how different methods for uncertainty-based prediction deferral (when models defer the result to a human reader): k-fold CV ensembles and virtual ensembles (VE; a CatBoost-specific technique which uses additive tree subsets to produce an ensemble of models). We test four different training regimes: with posterior sampling (a method which, in theory, provides better VE estimates) and k=3, k=5 and k=10 for CV ensembles. We repeat all experiments 10 times with different seeds, noting that for each, each dataset was divided into training (80%) and testing (20%) data.

We analyse the results using mixed effects linear models such that $\mathrm{AUC} \sim \mathrm{Approach} + (1 | \mathrm{dataset}) + (1 | \mathrm{dataset \times seed})$, where $\mathrm{AUC}$ is the area under the receiver operating curve, $\mathrm{Approach} \in \{\mathrm{Baseline}, \mathrm{CV(k=3)}, \mathrm{CV(k=5)}, \mathrm{CV(k=10)}, \mathrm{Posterior\ sampling} \}$, and $\mathrm{dataset}$ and $\mathrm{seed}$ refer to each dataset and the random seed, respectively. The interaction term aims to measure possible, differences associated with a data splitting. As sensitivity analyses, we compare the CV ensemble results to those obtained using other tree-based methods (random forests, LightGBM and XGBoost)

The main results of this analyses are as follows (here, performance is used interchangeably with AUC):

1. **Similar performance in CatBoost mmodels:** methods perform similarly when doing no deferral. The sole exception is that training with _posterior sampling_ leads to a drop in performance
2. **CV ensembles (CVE) lead to performance improvements, virtual ensembles (VE) _on their own_ don't:** whereas we see systematic increases in performance when performing deferral with CV ensembles, such is not the case when _only_ virtual ensembles are used. This implies that the theoretical effect of simulating model ensembles achieved through virtual ensembles is not sufficiently good to estimate uncertainty for an uncertainty-based deferral mechanism. Combining both CVE with VE does not improve on the performance observed for CVE alone
3. **Sensitivity analyses show that CatBoost outperforms other models:** while performance improvements are systematically observed when deferring with CV ensembles, performance is systematically lower for other models when compared with CatBoost, both with and without deferral.

The expected improvement when compared with the baseline: is ~0.01 for CVE (p=0.006) and no improvement for VE (p>0.05). The results for this are in @sec-compare-with-baseline.

# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(pROC)
library(ggsignif)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(patchwork)
library(emmeans)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

approach_palette <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, "Set1")
names(approach_palette) <- c(
  "Baseline", 
  "CV ensemble (k=3)", 
  "CV ensemble (k=5)", 
  "CV ensemble (k=10)",
  "Posterior sampling" 
)

format_pval <- function(x, prefix_p=FALSE) {
  out <- format.pval(x, eps = 1e-4, digits = 1, scientific = F) %>%
    gsub(pattern = "=<", replacement = "<")
  if (prefix_p) {
    out <- ifelse(
      grepl("<", out),
      sprintf("p %s",out),
      sprintf("p = %s",out)
    )
  }
  return(out)
}

auc_var_hanley_mcneill <- function(x) {
  a <- x$auc
  n1 <- length(x$cases)
  n2 <- length(x$controls)
  q1 <- a / (2 - a)
  q2 <- (2 * (a ^ 2)) / (1 + a)
  n <- a * (1 - a) + (n1 - 1) * (q1 - a ^ 2) + (n2 - 1) * (q2 - a ^ 2)
  d <- n1 * n2
  return(n / d)
}

theme_classic_2 <- function(base_size = 11,
                            base_family = "",
                            base_line_size = 11/22,
                            base_rect_size = 11/22) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size,
                base_family = base_family,
                base_line_size = base_line_size,
                base_rect_size = base_rect_size) %>%
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = base_size,
                                   colour = "black"),
          axis.title = element_text(size = base_size),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = base_size,
                                    face = "bold",
                                    hjust = 0.0,
                                    margin = margin(b = 2)),
          legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          legend.text = element_text(size = base_size),
          axis.line = element_line(),
          axis.ticks = element_line(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold")) %>%
    return
}
```

# Data loading and processing

```{r}
df <- read_csv("data/results.csv") %>%
  mutate(idx = seq(1, length(y_test))) %>%
  mutate(virtual_contains_0.5 = virtual_min < 0.5 & virtual_max > 0.5,
         cve_contains_0.5 = proba_min < 0.5 & proba_max > 0.5) %>%
  mutate(virtual_contains_0.5 = ifelse(is.na(virtual_contains_0.5), F, virtual_contains_0.5),
         cve_contains_0.5 = ifelse(is.na(cve_contains_0.5), F, cve_contains_0.5)) %>%
  group_by(approach, model, dataset, seed, nfolds, calibration) %>%
  mutate(N = length(unique(idx)) * 4,
         N_testing = length(unique(idx))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Calibration = calibration,
    Approach = case_when(
      grepl("baseline", approach) ~ "Baseline",
      grepl("cvensemble", approach) ~ "CV ensemble",
      grepl("posteriorsampling", approach) ~ "Posterior sampling"
    ),
    Approach = ifelse(
      Approach == "CV ensemble",
      sprintf("CV ensemble (k=%s)", nfolds),
      Approach
    ),
    Approach = factor(
      Approach,
      levels = names(approach_palette)
    )
  )

roc_df <- df %>% 
  subset(N > 100) %>%
  group_by(Approach, Calibration, model, dataset, seed, N, N_testing, nfolds) %>%
  summarise(
    roc_baseline = list(roc(y_test, proba_preds, direction = "<", levels = c(0, 1))),
    roc_ve = list(roc(y_test[!virtual_contains_0.5], proba_preds[!virtual_contains_0.5], 
                      direction = "<", levels = c(0, 1))),
    roc_cve = list(roc(y_test[!cve_contains_0.5], proba_preds[!cve_contains_0.5], 
                       direction = "<", levels = c(0, 1))),
    excluded_virtual = sum(virtual_contains_0.5),
    excluded_cve = sum(cve_contains_0.5),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 
auc_df <- roc_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    auc_baseline = as.numeric(roc_baseline$auc),
    auc_se_baseline = sqrt(auc_var_hanley_mcneill(roc_baseline)),
    auc_ve = as.numeric(roc_ve$auc),
    auc_se_ve = sqrt(auc_var_hanley_mcneill(roc_ve)),
    auc_cve = as.numeric(roc_cve$auc),
    auc_se_cve = sqrt(auc_var_hanley_mcneill(roc_cve)),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(auc_cve = ifelse(grepl("CV ensemble", Approach), auc_cve, NA)) %>%
  mutate(diff_ve = auc_ve - auc_baseline,
         diff_cve = auc_cve - auc_baseline) %>%
  select(-roc_baseline, -roc_ve, -roc_cve)
```

# Visualization

```{r}
#| fig.height: 6
#| fig.width: 7
exclusion_dataset_plot <- auc_df %>%
  subset(model == "catboost" & Calibration == T) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(dataset, N, seed, excluded_virtual, excluded_cve) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  gather(key = "key", value = "value", excluded_virtual, excluded_cve) %>%
  mutate(value = value / N) %>%
  mutate(key = ifelse(key == "excluded_cve", "CV ensembles", "Virtual ensembles")) %>%
  group_by(dataset, N, key) %>%
  summarise(
    value_sd = sd(value),
    value_se = value_sd / sqrt(length(value)),
    value = mean(value)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = reorder(dataset,N), fill = key, 
             xmin = value - value_se, xmax = value + value_se)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_linerange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(name = "Exclusion based on...", palette = "Set1") +
  coord_cartesian(expand = F) + 
  theme_classic_2(base_size = 8) +
  xlab("% excluded") +
  ylab("Dataset") + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "vertical") + 
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", x * 100)) 

dataset_auc_plot <- auc_df %>%
  subset(model %in% c("catboost") & Calibration == T) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = auc_value,
             y = reorder(sprintf("%s (n=%s)", dataset, N), N), 
             fill = Approach,
             group = Approach)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  theme_classic_2(base_size = 8) + 
  xlab("AUC") +
  ylab("Dataset (>100 samples total)") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0, 0.01, 0.01)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "vertical")

dataset_auc_diffs_ve_plot <- auc_df %>%
  subset(model %in% c("catboost") & Calibration == T) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(sprintf("%s (n=%s)", dataset, N), N), 
             colour = Approach,
             group = Approach)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(x = diff_ve),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    size = 0.25) +

  ylab("Dataset (>100 samples total)") +

  scale_colour_manual(values = approach_palette) +

  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +

dataset_auc_diffs_cve_plot <- auc_df %>%

  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(sprintf("%s (n=%s)", dataset, N), N),

    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),

no_axis_text_y <- theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                        axis.title.y = element_blank())

dataset_auc_diffs_ve_plot |
```

# Formal analysis

## Differences in performance between training regimes

```{r}
auc_df_subset <- filter(auc_df, model == "catboost", Calibration) %>%
  mutate(weights = 1 / auc_se_baseline ^ 2)

auc_model <- lmer(
  auc_baseline ~ Approach + (1 | dataset:seed) + (1 | dataset), 
  data = auc_df_subset,
  weights = auc_df_subset$weights
)

summary(auc_model)

emm_auc <- emmeans(auc_model, specs = c("Approach"))

pairs_auc <- pairs(emm_auc)

data.frame(pairs_auc) %>%
  select(Contrast = contrast, `Difference estimate` = estimate, SE, `p-value` = p.value) %>%
  kable(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling()
```

## Differences in performance between sample exclusion methods

```{r}
auc_df_subset <- filter(auc_df, model == "catboost", Calibration) %>%
  mutate(
    se_total_ve = sqrt(auc_se_baseline ^ 2 + auc_se_ve ^ 2),
    se_total_cve = sqrt(auc_se_baseline ^ 2 + auc_se_cve ^ 2),
    weights_ve = 1 / se_total_ve ^ 2,
    weights_cve = 1 / se_total_cve ^ 2
  )

ve_model <- lmer(
  diff_ve ~ Approach + (1 | dataset:seed) + (1 | dataset), 
  data = auc_df_subset,
  weights = auc_df_subset$weights_ve
)
cve_model <- lmer(
  diff_cve ~ Approach + (1 | dataset:seed) + (1 | dataset), 
  data = auc_df_subset,
  weights = auc_df_subset$weights_cve
)

summary(ve_model)
summary(cve_model)

emm_ve <- emmeans(ve_model, specs = c("Approach"))
emm_cve <- emmeans(cve_model, specs = c("Approach"))

pairs_ve <- pairs(emm_ve)
pairs_cve <- pairs(emm_cve)
```

### Visualization

```{r}
#| fig.height: 1.5
#| fig.width: 5.5
plot_data <- data.frame(pairs_ve) %>%
  mutate(contrast1 = str_match(contrast, ".*(?= - )"),
         contrast2 = str_match(contrast, "(?<= - ).*")) %>%
  subset(contrast1 == "Baseline") %>%
  mutate(contrast1 = factor(contrast1, names(approach_palette)),
         contrast2 = factor(contrast2, names(approach_palette)))

rect_coords <- plot_data %>%
  subset(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  summarise(xmin = min(-estimate - SE), 
            ymin = min(as.numeric(contrast2)) - 1,
            xmax = max(-estimate + SE), 
            ymax = max(as.numeric(contrast2)) - 1)

pairs_ve_plot <- plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = contrast2, 
             x = -estimate, 
             xmin = -estimate - SE, 
             xmax = -estimate + SE,
             colour = contrast2)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(label = format_pval(p.value, T)), colour = "black",
            size = 2.5, vjust = -1) +
  geom_linerange() +
  annotate(geom = "rect",
           xmin = rect_coords$xmin - 0.001, 
           xmax = rect_coords$xmax + 0.001, 
           ymin = rect_coords$ymin - 0.25, 
           ymax = rect_coords$ymax + 0.75,
           fill = NA,
           colour = "black") +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = rect_coords$xmin - 0.001,
    y = rect_coords$ymax + 0.75,
    label = "Stat. identical, better than Posterior sampling",
    vjust = -0.4,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 2.5
  ) + 
  theme_classic_2(base_size = 8) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("AUC difference vs. virtual ensembles baseline") +
  ylab("Approach") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = approach_palette)

pairs_ve_plot
```

```{r}
data.frame(pairs_cve) %>%
  select(Contrast = contrast, `Difference estimate` = estimate, SE, `p-value` = p.value) %>%
  kable(digits = 6) %>%
  kable_styling()
```

## Comparison of post-deferral with baseline performance {#sec-compare-with-baseline}

```{r}
auc_df_subset <- filter(auc_df, model == "catboost", Calibration) %>%
  mutate(
    se_total_ve = sqrt(auc_se_baseline ^ 2 + auc_se_ve ^ 2),
    se_total_cve = sqrt(auc_se_baseline ^ 2 + auc_se_cve ^ 2),
    weights_ve = 1 / se_total_ve ^ 2,
    weights_cve = 1 / se_total_cve ^ 2
  ) 
auc_df_baseline <- auc_df_subset %>%
  subset(Approach == "Baseline") %>%
  select(dataset, seed, auc_baseline = auc_baseline)
auc_df_others <- auc_df_subset %>%
  select(dataset, seed, 
         Approach,
         auc_ve = auc_ve,
         weights_ve = weights_ve,
         auc_cve = auc_cve,
         weights_cve = weights_ve)

auc_comparisons <- merge(auc_df_baseline, auc_df_others, by = c("dataset", "seed")) %>%
  mutate(diff_ve = auc_ve - auc_baseline,
         diff_cve = auc_cve - auc_baseline)

ve_model <- lmer(
  diff_ve ~ Approach + (1 | dataset:seed) + (1 | dataset), 
  data = auc_comparisons,
  weights = auc_comparisons$weights_ve
)
cve_model <- lmer(
  diff_cve ~ Approach + (1 | dataset:seed) + (1 | dataset), 
  data = auc_comparisons,
  weights = auc_comparisons$weights_cve
)

summary(ve_model)$coefficients %>%
  kable(digits = 5) %>%
  kable_styling()

summary(cve_model)$coefficients %>%
  kable(digits = 5) %>%
  kable_styling()
```

## Comparison with other models

### General AUC

```{r}
auc_df_subset <- filter(
  auc_df, 
  Calibration, Approach != "Posterior sampling") %>%
  mutate(weights = 1 / auc_se_baseline ^ 2)

auc_model <- lmer(
  auc_baseline ~ Approach + model + (1 | dataset:seed) + (1 | dataset), 
  data = auc_df_subset,
  weights = auc_df_subset$weights
)

summary(auc_model)

emm_auc_approach <- emmeans(auc_model, specs = c("Approach"))
emm_auc_model <- emmeans(auc_model, specs = c("model"))

pairs_auc_approach <- pairs(emm_auc_approach)
pairs_auc_model <- pairs(emm_auc_model)

data.frame(pairs_auc_approach) %>%
  select(Contrast = contrast, `Difference estimate` = estimate, SE, `p-value` = p.value) %>%
  kable(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling()

data.frame(pairs_auc_model) %>%
  mutate(p.value = format.pval(p.value, digits = 1, eps = 1e-4), scientific=F) %>%
  select(Contrast = contrast, `Difference estimate` = estimate, SE, 
         `p-value` = p.value) %>%
  kable(digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling()
```

### Post-deferral AUC

```{r}
auc_model <- lmer(
  auc_cve ~ Approach + model + (1 | dataset:seed) + (1 | dataset), 
  data = auc_df_subset,
  weights = auc_df_subset$weights
)

summary(auc_model)

emm_auc_approach <- emmeans(auc_model, specs = c("Approach"))
emm_auc_model <- emmeans(auc_model, specs = c("model"))

pairs_auc_approach <- pairs(emm_auc_approach)
pairs_auc_model <- pairs(emm_auc_model)

data.frame(pairs_auc_approach) %>%
  select(Contrast = contrast, `Difference estimate` = estimate, SE, `p-value` = p.value) %>%
  kable(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling()

data.frame(pairs_auc_model) %>%
  mutate(p.value = format.pval(p.value, digits = 1, eps = 1e-4), scientific=F) %>%
  select(Contrast = contrast, `Difference estimate` = estimate, SE, 
         `p-value` = p.value) %>%
  kable(digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling()
```

### Performance improvements

```{r}
auc_df_subset <- filter(auc_df, Calibration, Approach != "Posterior sampling") %>%
  mutate(
    se_total_ve = sqrt(auc_se_baseline ^ 2 + auc_se_ve ^ 2),
    se_total_cve = sqrt(auc_se_baseline ^ 2 + auc_se_cve ^ 2),
    weights_ve = 1 / se_total_ve ^ 2,
    weights_cve = 1 / se_total_cve ^ 2
  )

cve_model <- lmer(
  diff_cve ~ Approach + model + (1 | dataset:seed) + (1 | dataset), 
  data = auc_df_subset,
  weights = auc_df_subset$weights_cve
)

summary(cve_model)

emm_cve_approach <- emmeans(cve_model, specs = c("Approach"))
emm_cve_model <- emmeans(cve_model, specs = c("model"))

pairs_cve_approach <- pairs(emm_cve_approach)
pairs_cve_model <- pairs(emm_cve_model)

data.frame(pairs_cve_approach) %>%
  select(Contrast = contrast, `Difference estimate` = estimate, SE, `p-value` = p.value) %>%
  kable(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling()

data.frame(pairs_cve_model) %>%
  mutate(p.value = format.pval(p.value, digits = 1, eps = 1e-4), scientific=F) %>%
  select(Contrast = contrast, `Difference estimate` = estimate, SE, 
         `p-value` = p.value) %>%
  kable(digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling()
```
